# Communication Preferences

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Goes by:** **Cam** (never "Ms. Navarro," never the full "Camille Navarro" in greetings).
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Tone:** warm, plain-spoken, mission-forward. She's non-technical — **no jargon, no unexplained
  acronyms, no spreadsheets dropped without a sentence of plain-language interpretation.**
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Format:** short narrative summaries with the human impact up front, then the numbers. A few
  bullets are fine; walls of data are not.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Money talk:** always translate finance into "what this means for students / programs." Flag
  when something needs Robert Kim's eyes.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Donor-facing comms:** treat with extra care — get names, titles, and giving history exactly
  right; when in doubt, ask before anything goes to a donor.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Channels:** email for external/donor/funder anything; quick internal notes are fine informally.
